full_details: In the morning the music for Errors came in four bars early. Phillips moved it to the fifth bar, and Cowley came in on that bar and not before. At the Theatre, before the play, Richard Field called from the shop. He had Millington's little book in his hand. He called the presswork honest and the copy dishonest, and he asked you to be angry at his table on Sunday and not in Paul's. You said you had not been angry. You had been curious whose it was. He said the man who entered it. You said the plays are not yours to print. They are the company's. He asked about the Holinshed. You said Sunday, and not the Holinshed. At two you played. The plot named you as a player and named no author. After the play you walked to the Bell. Hobbins was in. You gave him Susanna's letter, written on the twenty-sixth, at twopence. He had nothing for you this time. At home the parliament sheet was still blank, and the chronicle was still in the house.
one_sentence: You took Field's call from the shop, played Errors at two, and gave Hobbins Susanna's letter at the Bell.
title: Sunday at Field's table, and Susanna's letter
